decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal would represent unacceptable backland development which would, by reason of insufficient visibility splays and substandard access for pedestrians, fail to provide satisfactory vehicular and pedestrian access to Vicarage Farm Road, and would thereby be likely to result in conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safe movement of pedestrians and vehicles in the area, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.3 (Backland Development/Infill Development), T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking & Servicing Facilities for Developments) and T.4.4 (Road Safety) of the Council's adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - Due to its excessive residential density, the proposal would represent an overdevelopment of the site, which would provide cramped accommodation, inadequate privacy and substandard private amenity space for future residents. The proposal is therefore contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and H.4.2 (Residential Density) of the Council's adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development, due to its due to its size, layout, position and appearance, would represent an overbearing and unneighbourly development, and would cause loss of privacy and outlook for adjoining residents, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and H.6.3 (Backland Development/ Infill Development) of the Council's adopted Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of 3 storey building comprising 7 two bedroom flats and 4 one bedroom flats with associated landscaping and parking.
